name: Data file clean-up loop
why: Fixes a messy file in rounds, re-checking until it passes and saving the rules for the next export, the same check-then-fix loop as the rules skill.

name: Prepare lab data for a checked import
why: Maps exports to a target schema and returns an import exception list, a worked example of a pre-import check.

name: Excel table join reconciler
why: Joins two tables on a key and lists unmatched rows and duplicate keys, the 'linked' and 'unique' rule groups in a workbook.

name: Excel input form builder
why: Builds an entry form with dropdowns and duplicate checks, so new data comes in clean instead of being fixed later.

name: Check a spreadsheet before sharing the results
why: Finds broken formulas and wrong totals before a sheet goes out, a companion to the weekly data quality check.

name: Align recurring report metric definitions
why: Explains why two reports disagree on one metric, useful when a glossary term means different things to different teams.

name: Document a dataset analysis for reproduction
why: Writes a data inventory and method so someone else can repeat the work, close to the lineage notes in the dictionary skill.

name: Agent database migration planner
why: Plans a change that keeps existing data, with staging checks and recovery steps, for moves that end in a database.

name: Launch readiness seam checker
why: Checks the joins between parts of a migration or launch and plans a run-through, a second view on the cut-over checklist.

name: Monthly catalogue clean-up keeper
why: Finds missing costs, clashing SKUs and hidden products each month, a ready-made quality routine for shop product data.

name: Warehouse count discrepancy review assistant
why: Splits stock count differences into timing, unit and count errors, the root-cause habit applied to inventory data.
